newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean June fishmeal exports slump.
newsitem.headline: Chilean June fishmeal exports slump.

text.p: Chilean fishmeal exports dropped to $34.8 million in June from $67.9 million in the same month last year as a result of bans imposed on mackerel fishing, said the central bank in its monthly report.
The government has kept fleets in port for three months since January to protect young fish drawn to coastal waters by warm currents associated with the El Nino climatic phenonenon.
Chile is the world's second largest fishneal producer after Peru.
